title_youtube: the first Thanksgiving had 5 deer and zero air fryers
description_youtube:
A completely useless Thanksgiving fact, with real history: your air fryer missed the first Thanksgiving.

What we actually know about the 1621 harvest feast at Plymouth comes mostly from one letter by colonist Edward Winslow:
- About 90 Wampanoag men came with their leader Massasoit.
- They went out and brought five deer.
- There were roughly 50 colonists; English hunters had gone fowling for wild birds.
- The feasting and games lasted three days.
- Air fryers present: zero (they were invented in the 2000s).

Useless Facts is our series of true facts nobody needed. What actually sits at the head of your Thanksgiving table?

Sources:
- Massachusetts Commonwealth Museum, Thanksgiving mysteries (Winslow's account: Massasoit and ninety men, five deer, three days): https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/commonwealth-museum/exhibits/online/thanksgiving/thanksgiving-mysteries-3.htm
- TIME, The first Thanksgiving: Winslow's letter, five deer, three days of feasting: https://time.com/5021704/the-first-thanksgiving/
- History.com, Colonists at the first Thanksgiving: https://www.history.com/news/first-thanksgiving-colonists-native-americans-men
